description: This file defines the ProxyDrawable class, a custom Drawable that acts as a proxy to another Drawable object, delegating drawing and property methods to the wrapped Drawable instance.

classes.name: ProxyDrawable
classes.description: A Drawable subclass that delegates its drawing operations to another Drawable, acting as a proxy.

methods.name: ProxyDrawable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the proxy with a target Drawable.

methods.name: setProxy
methods.description: Sets a new proxy Drawable, avoiding self-assignment.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Delegates drawing to the proxy Drawable.

methods.name: getIntrinsicWidth
methods.description: Returns the intrinsic width of the proxy, or -1 if null.

methods.name: getIntrinsicHeight
methods.description: Returns the intrinsic height of the proxy, or -1 if null.

methods.name: getOpacity
methods.description: Returns the opacity of the proxy, or transparent if null.

methods.name: setFilterBitmap
methods.description: Sets the filter bitmap flag on the proxy drawable.

methods.name: setDither
methods.description: Sets the dither flag on the proxy drawable.

methods.name: setColorFilter
methods.description: Sets a color filter on the proxy drawable.

methods.name: setAlpha
methods.description: Sets the alpha transparency on the proxy drawable.

methods.name: mutate
methods.description: Mutates both this drawable and its proxy to ensure they are not shared.
